description:
1. Create a temporary workspace named "temp_check" to hold intermediate artifacts and logs.  
2. Retrieve the current value and associated type metadata of the variable named var and save that raw capture to "temp_check/var_raw.txt".  
3. Produce a normalized textual representation of the value (trimmed and canonicalized) and save it to "temp_check/var_normalized.txt".  
4. Attempt a conversion of the normalized representation into an integer-like canonical form, recording the conversion result and any errors to "temp_check/var_conversion.txt".  
5. Perform a consistency check between the original metadata in "var_raw.txt" and the conversion outcome in "var_conversion.txt", and write a boolean verification flag with an explanatory note to "temp_check/var_verification.txt".  
6. Clean up any temporary artifacts not needed for the final assessment, retaining only "var_raw.txt", "var_conversion.txt", and "var_verification.txt" in "temp_check".  
7. Create a concise summary file "temp_check/ready_for_decision.txt" that contains the verification flag and key evidence, marking the workspace as prepared to make the final yes/no determination (do not produce the decision yet).

Test if variable var is an integer? If so, tell me "yes", otherwise tell me "no". (Without quotes)
